sync_caution_mes.message:
[Notice]
・Automatic synchronization is performed at a minimum interval of every 10 minutes.
・Due to differential synchronization, download history prior to enabling synchronization will not be synced.
・Processes such as importing download history or initialization are not synced.
・If you do not wish to use the synchronization feature, please turn it off.
